HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MANOJ KUMAR OHRI  ORDER % 08.08.2025 CRL.M.A. 19568/2025 (exemption)
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. The application is disposed of.

CRL.M.(BAIL) 1463/2025 (suspension of sentence)
1. The present application has been filed seeking suspension of sentence during the pendency of the appeal.

2. By way of the present appeal, the appellant seeks to assail the judgement of conviction dated 05.07.2022 vide which he has been convicted for offences punishable under Section 6 of POCSO Act and Sections 376(2)(f)(n) and 506 IPC and order on sentence dated 28.04.2023 vide which he has been directed to undergo rigorous imprisonment for a period of 10 years for the offence punishable under Sections 6 of POCSO Act alongwith payment of fine of Rs.5,000/-, in default whereof he was directed to further undergo simple imprisonment for a period of two months and

were directed to run concurrently.
3. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the condition of the appellant's mother has worsened since he was last released on interim bail vide order dated 22.11.2024.
He further submits that while releasing the appellant, this Court had taken into account the verification report filed in the Court.

As per the nominal roll dated 04.08.2025, the appellant has undergone 7 years and 29 days with remission earned 6 months and 14 days and unexpired portion is 2 years, 4 months and 17 days as on 01.08.2025.

The nominal roll further records that the interim bail was granted twice from 22.11.2023 to 05.12.2023 and 19.12.2024 to 15.01.2025 and as the appellant could not arrange the surety as per order dated 17.12.2024, he was released on personal bond of Rs.20,000/- only,
thereafter the appellant duly surrendered.
4.
Learned APP for the State, duly assisted by learned counsel for the complainant, has opposed the present application.

5. Keeping in view the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, the sentence of the appellant is suspended for a period of 3 weeks from the date of his release on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.20,000/- to the satisfaction of the concerned Trial Court/link JM/Jail Superintendent and also subject to the further following conditions: -
i.

The appellant shall provide his mobile number to the Investigating Officer (IO)
concerned, which shall be kept in working condition at all times.
The appellant shall not switch off, or change the same without prior intimation to the IO
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 09/08/2025 at 00:17:41 concerned;
ii.
The appellant will furnish his permanent address to the IO and in case he changes his address, he will inform the IO concerned and this Court also;
iii. The appellant shall appear before the Court as and when the appeal is taken up for hearing;
iv. The appellant shall not leave the country without permission from the competent Court and if the appellant has a passport, he shall surrender the same to the Jail Superintendent;
6. With the above directions, the application is disposed of.
7. A copy of this order be communicated electronically forthwith to the concerned Jail Superintendent for information.
